name: CastleAshlar
height_note: H 0..65535 spans height_range_m; mid level about 0.790

colour_spaces.N: linear, OpenGL (+Y up); flip green on Unreal import
colour_spaces.ORM: linear; R AO, G roughness, B metallic 0
colour_spaces.Macro: linear; R large, G medium, B small low-frequency variation, sample at 1/6 to 1/10 of the tile UV scale

method: Poly Haven rock_wall_08 (coursed squared blocks, worn arrises, lost mortar) height-blended with a shifted copy of itself to break its period, laid 1.83x larger than life (tile 3.3 m) so its 0.3 m blocks stand at the 0.55 m courses of the original castle; relief and normals rescaled to match; faint ochre run-off streaks; graded grey-green
known_weaknesses: enlarged scan: texel density 620 px/m and the stone grain is 1.8x coarse close up; one scan
